records.text: The Daily Wire sued Candace Owens for letting USS Liberty survivor Phil Tourney tell his story and alleged that she had manipulated him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They sued me for allowing a survivor to tell his story and they were making it a psychic argument that I put him up to it like I could ever be so disgusting as to manipulate a man to say something so that I could like I mean it was and then I had to actually call Phil after this and say I'm going to court.

verification.notes: The statement describes a private legal dispute involving Daily Wire, Owens, and Phil Tourney. Current searches found no public complaint, arbitration record, or other independently reviewable filing confirming the allegation.

records.text: USS Liberty crew members were threatened, placed under a gag order, and unable to speak about the attack.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: It wasn't. There was a lot of investigation where they weren't actually the crew of the USS Liberty were threatened. ... They had a gag order. They couldn't talk.

verification.notes: Survivor accounts and the independent commission material entered into the Congressional Record describe crew members being ordered not to discuss the USS Liberty attack and threatened with severe penalties. The evidence is retrospective and partly testimonial, so confidence is medium.

sources.title: Congressional Record — Independent Commission of Inquiry into the USS Liberty Attack
sources.relevance: Records survivor testimony and commission findings concerning orders and threats intended to suppress discussion of the attack.

records.text: After fighting the USS Liberty matter for 15 years, Israel paid six million dollars for damages and six million dollars for the victims.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: And you know the beauty about this is that for 15 years Israel fought this tooth and nail and they finally paid compensation. ... Six million dollars for damages in the USS Liberties and six million dollars for the victims of the USS Liberty.

verification.notes: Official compensation records show approximately 3.32 million dollars for death claims, approximately 3.57 million dollars for injury claims, and a final 6 million dollar property settlement. The amounts are close in aggregate, but the final settlement came in 1980, roughly thirteen years after the 1967 attack rather than fifteen.

sources.relevance: Provides the diplomatic record for the property-damage claim and settlement.

records.text: The USS Liberty investigation was a cover-up and the attack was deliberate.
records.speaker: Ward Boston

appearances.snippet: Ama Musa writes, Ward Boston was a Navy judge advocate general who investigated Liberty, ... U.S. Liberty. ... Before he died, he published a notarized statement in San Diego Union Tribune that the investigation was a cover up and the attack was deliberate. It's the most obvious deliberate attack.

verification.notes: Ward Boston, senior counsel to the Navy Court of Inquiry, did issue a sworn declaration saying he and Admiral Kidd believed the attack deliberate and that the inquiry was ordered to reach a mistaken-identity conclusion. This verifies Boston’s attributed statement; it does not erase the continuing dispute or independently establish the attack’s intent.

sources.title: Declaration of Ward Boston, Jr., Captain, JAGC, USN (Ret.)
sources.relevance: Reproduces Boston’s sworn declaration and the precise deliberate-attack and ordered-conclusion allegations.

sources.title: News Brief: Ward Boston alleges USS Liberty investigation cover-up
sources.relevance: Contemporary independent report confirms Boston made the allegation and identifies his role in the inquiry.

records.text: Israel attacked America in the Lavon Affair and the USS Liberty incident and got away with it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That's right. He only allows Israel to do that. Only Israel is allowed to attack America. Only Israel got to get away with the Lavon Affair. ... Only Israel is allowed to get away with what they did at the USS Liberty. That is a right reserved for Israel to attack and use Americans to maim and caricature people.

verification.notes: Context reviewed at 49:48. Israel's military intelligence did conduct the Lavon Affair false-flag bomb plot against American- and British-owned sites in Egypt, and Israeli forces did attack the U.S. Navy ship Liberty. But the Lavon plot was not an attack on U.S. territory, Israel apologized for Liberty while intent remains disputed, and 'got away with it' is evaluative.

sources.title: The Lavon Affair - Israel Ministry of Defense Archives
sources.relevance: Confirms the Israeli covert operation attacked American-owned civilian sites in Egypt, but not U.S. territory.

sources.title: USS Liberty Incident - Naval History and Heritage Command
sources.relevance: Confirms the Israeli attack on USS Liberty and records Israel's mistaken-identity explanation and U.S. investigations, so intent remains disputed.

records.text: Candace Owens accused Israel of intentionally attacking the USS Liberty in order to draw the United States into a wider war.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The interview went viral of the treatment that he endured as a actual survivor of a horrific attack of what Israel did intentionally and consciously to our servicemen when they thought they were going to help Israel because they wanted to drag us into a wider war.

verification.notes: The U.S. Naval History and Heritage Command’s official reconstruction attributes the USS Liberty attack to identification and communications failures and records that Israeli headquarters recognized the American flag only after the attack. It provides no support for an intentional plan to draw the United States into a wider war.

sources.title: U.S. Naval History and Heritage Command: Attack on USS Liberty—Additional Detail
sources.relevance: Official Navy reconstruction documents misidentification and communications failures rather than the asserted motive.
